paper_title: Tighter Bounds for the Oblivious Bit-Fixing Inner Product Extractor on Biased Seeds
statement: The first version of an IPE-specific EGLHL given in Lemma 29 was limited in its usefulness because it requires us to prove a concrete bound on EIF(j) for every j ∈ [4, n], and we do not know how to prove such bounds for any j > 4. On the other hand, we know how to 2 concretely compute the second version for any n, but only in 2O(n ) time. In the full version of this paper, we perform this exponential computation for n ∈ {4, 6, 8} and report the concrete bounds that result.
